n, m = map(int, input().split())

if n > m:
    n, m = m, n

INFINITY = 1000000000
size = 1 << n

dp = [[INFINITY] * size for _ in range(size)]
for i in range(size):
    dp[0][i] = 0

for step in range(m):
    nextStates = [[INFINITY] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for prevMask in range(size):
        for currMask in range(size):
            if dp[prevMask][currMask] != INFINITY:
                limit = 1 if step == m - 1 else size
                for nextMask in range(limit):
                    covered = 0
                    for i in range(n):
                        if ((1 << i) & currMask) == 0:
                            up = i - 1
                            down = i + 1
                            if up >= 0 and ((1 << up) & currMask) != 0:
                                covered |= 1 << i
                            if down < n and ((1 << down) & currMask) != 0:
                                covered |= 1 << i
                            if ((1 << i) & prevMask) != 0:
                                covered |= 1 << i
                            if ((1 << i) & nextMask) != 0:
                                covered |= 1 << i
                    cost = dp[prevMask][currMask] + n - bin(covered).count('1')
                    if cost < nextStates[prevMask][nextMask]:
                        nextStates[prevMask][nextMask] = cost
    dp = nextStates

minCost = INFINITY
for row in dp:
    for val in row:
        if val < minCost:
            minCost = val

print(n * m - minCost)
